item.title: Paro
item.description: Paro Valley, one of the most scenic regions in Bhutan Paro is a picturesque town in western Bhutan, located not far from the capital city, Thimphu. It is renowned for its natural beauty, cultural landmarks, and as the main international gateway to the country. Airport Paro is home to Bhutan’s only international airport. The airport is famous for its challenging approach, as it lies in a narrow valley surrounded by high mountains.
